pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhaddāya kāpilāniyā antevāsinī bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā gāmake ñātikulaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.3: bhaddā kāpilānī taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apassantī bhikkhuniyo pucchi kahaṃ itthannāmā na dissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.4: bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ayye bhaṇḍitvā na dissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.5: ammā amukasmiṃ gāmake etissā ñātikulaṃ tattha gantvā vicinathāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.6: bhikkhuniyo tattha gantvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ passitvā etadavocuṃ kissa tvaṃ ayye ekikā āgatā kaccisi appadhaṃsitāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.8: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.13: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gaccheyya ayampi bhikkhunī paṭhamāpattikaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhuniyo sāketā sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.

pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo kosalesu janapadesu sāvatthiṃ gacchantā sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.2: tattha aññatarā bhikkhunī abhirūpā hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā. aññataro puriso tassā bhikkhuniyā saha dassanena paṭibaddhacitto hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.3: athakho so puriso tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ seyyaṃ paññāpento tassā bhikkhuniyā seyyaṃ ekamantaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.4: athakho sā bhikkhunī sallakkhetvā pariyuṭṭhito ayaṃ puriso sace rattiṃ āgacchissati vissaro me bhavissatīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.5: bhikkhuniyo anāpucchā aññataraṃ kulaṃ gantvā seyyaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.6: athakho so puriso rattiṃ āgantvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ gavesanto bhikkhuniyo ghaṭṭesi.
